name: War-Awoken Glacial Frost (Weapon Skill)
name_jp: 戦醒フロス・グラキエス
effects:
Single-target Ice/Dark/NE piercing magic attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Ice/Dark Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold with at least 0/2 En-Ice/Dark members
WS Blue: Dualcast Ice/Dark, Instant Ice/Dark & Weakness Damage +30% for 3 turns to user
WS Gold: Dualcast Ice/Dark, Instant Ice/Dark & Weakness Damage +30% for 2 turns to party
